current_architecture: interface discovery/normalization -> active behavioral identification -> source-specific ABI/action adapter -> common or fusion-safe latent state-transition representation -> top-dominant sparse fusion -> learned stream segmentation/program composition

active_probe_without_enumeration.decision: allow UNRESOLVED; bounded proposal disagreement search replaces full-domain enumeration in this finite SHADOW screen

unseen_grammar.boundary: command surface itself was already behaviorally grounded; only wrapper/position was unseen

learned_stage_segmentation.segmenter: causal GRU trained on delimiter-free normalized streams depth1-3
learned_stage_segmentation.boundary: grounded command pairs are abstracted before segmentation; stage grammar is synthetic

latent_geometry.hand_binary5: matches explicit common-action result in earlier screen
latent_geometry.boundary: learned6 uses known state identity + desired fusion law, not transition semantics; source adapters still form action probabilities before projection

command_surface_paraphrase.protocol: canonical behavior grounding; no behavior query on paraphrase; component substitution learned from paired unlabeled seen-command views; heldout paraphrase is unseen component combination
command_surface_paraphrase.boundary: synthetic compositional cipher with parallel interface evidence, not natural-language paraphrase

negative_boundaries: arbitrary semantic permutation is not zero-shot identifiable
arbitrary whole-action random codebook does not few-shot generalize
structure-only interface discovery does not extrapolate all unseen grammars
fixed finite behavior probes can be spoofed
transition topology alone does not automatically yield a low-dimensional fusion-safe latent geometry
